title: One Person's Trash Is Another Person's Treasure
topic: Why trash beats garbage in a saying about what people value.

source.author: VOA Learning English
source.origin: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories
source.license: Public domain (work of the US federal government)

body: People around the world share many things in common. But we are also different from each other. Not only do we look, think, and act differently, but we also like different things. Even identical twins may look the same but are very different individuals.
On today’s program, we will look at a few expressions to describe how no person is exactly the same as another.
The first expression involves trash and treasure.
When we say one person's trash is another person's treasure, we mean that something that one person may consider worthless could be highly prized or valued by someone else.
Now, rubbish and garbage mean the same as trash. But, in this expression, we use trash because the “tr” in trash and treasure makes the expression sound more natural. It just sounds better.
And, sometimes, we use the word "man" in place of "person" such as one man’s trash is another man’s treasure. Again it is just easier to say.
Another expression with a similar meaning is different strokes for different folks.
This also means that different things appeal to different people. But as a set expression, we do not say “different strokes for different people.” That just doesn't sound right.
Different strokes for different folks can also mean that people live in different ways and value different things.

quiz.q: What does the expression 'one person's trash is another person's treasure' mean?
options: everyone likes the exact same things
trash is more valuable than treasure to everyone
something worthless to one person may be valuable to another

quiz.q: Why does the expression use the word 'trash' instead of 'rubbish' or 'garbage'?
options: because rubbish is not used in American English
because trash and treasure start with a similar sound
because garbage is considered impolite to say

quiz.q: What does 'different strokes for different folks' mean?
options: different things appeal to different people
everyone secretly wants the same things
people should copy their neighbours' choices
